key_points: Q3 core sales rose 19% to $5.08B, beating estimates on strong AI-driven optical demand
Management targets $40B annualized sales run rate by 2030, signaling confidence in structural growth
Multiple analysts (UBS, Truist) cut price targets on valuation grounds, not fundamentals, keeping Buy ratings
Stock has pulled back ~14% over the past month despite earnings beat, creating valuation debate
Near-term overhang from valuation concerns vs. long-term AI optical tailwind
